## Follow-up commit `078ff305` — the TEST_DEBT ratchet, and why no ledger number moved

The first push went red on **TypeScript Type Check**: `@objectstack/formula`'s
TEST_DEBT entry records 17 raw `tsc` errors and the re-measure reported 19 (+2).

**Cause, measured.** `packages/formula/tsconfig.json` excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula typecheck` never reads this test file — which
is exactly why the local run was clean and the gate was not.
`check-type-check-coverage --re-measure` reads it with the exclusion lifted
(#5278). Under the package's CommonJS-targeted config each `import.meta` costs
two raw errors, `TS1470` + `TS2339`, and the new pin had introduced a **second**
`import.meta.url` alongside the one the existing import-graph test already pays
for:

```
src/rls-predicate.test.ts(135,40): error TS1470: The 'import.meta' meta-property is not allowed in files which will build into CommonJS output.
src/rls-predicate.test.ts(135,52): error TS2339: Property 'url' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'.
src/rls-predicate.test.ts(176,25): error TS1470: ...   <- new
src/rls-predicate.test.ts(176,37): error TS2339: ...   <- new
```

**Fix: route 1, no ledger edit.** The directory is now resolved once into a
module-level `HERE` constant, read by both the pre-existing import-graph
assertion and the new `@example` pin. Re-measured with the gate's own method
(formula's own tsconfig with the test exclusion lifted, its `spec` closure
built): **19 before, 17 after** — exactly the recorded number. Nothing was
raised, so no debt is laundered and no `note` needed rewriting.

**No pin was weakened.** The `@example` extraction from `rls.zod.ts`, the
`isSupportedRlsExpression` round-trip, the anti-vacuity guard
(`expect(examples.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3)`) and the post-image
semantics all stand unchanged, and the reverse verification was re-run **after**
the refactor to prove the pin is still live:

```
FAIL  every `check` @example passes the ADR-0056 D4 shape gate
FAIL  the `check` enumerated-values example is a CEL bracket list that means "one of these"
      Tests  2 failed | 9 passed (11)
```

Worth recording for the next author, since it cost this PR a lap: in a package
whose tsconfig hides its tests, `pnpm typecheck` is **not** the check the CI
ratchet runs. The reproducing command is the package's own config with the
exclusion dropped.

**CI at `078ff305`:** all checks completed, every one `success` — ESLint,
TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, Test Core (3/3 + aggregate), Dogfood
Regression Gate (3/3 + aggregate), Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance,
Spec property liveness, Build Core.
